ayahs.translation: When the heaven is cleft asunder
When the seas are poured forth
A soul will know what it hath sent before (it) and what left behind

ayahs.text: يَٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنُ مَا غَرَّكَ بِرَبِّكَ ٱلْكَرِيمِ
ayahs.translation: O man! What hath made thee careless concerning thy Lord, the Bountiful
Who created thee, then fashioned, then proportioned thee

ayahs.text: فِىٓ أَىِّ صُورَةٍ مَّا شَآءَ رَكَّبَكَ
ayahs.translation: Into whatsoever form He will, He casteth thee
Nay, but ye deny the Judgment
Lo! there are above you guardians
Lo! the righteous verily will be in delight
And lo! the wicked verily will be in hell
They will burn therein on the Day of Judgment
And will not be absent thence
Ah, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

ayahs.text: ثُمَّ مَآ أَدْرَىٰكَ مَا يَوْمُ ٱلدِّينِ
ayahs.translation: Again, what will convey unto thee what the Day of Judgment is

ayahs.text: يَوْمَ لَا تَمْلِكُ نَفْسٌ لِّنَفْسٍ شَيْـًٔا وَٱلْأَمْرُ يَوْمَئِذٍ لِّلَّهِ
ayahs.translation: A day on which no soul hath power at all for any (other) soul. The (absolute) command on that day is Allah's
